content: Generating absent keyphrases on scientific publication datasets is a rather challenging problem. Existing studies often achieve seemingly good performance by measuring recall on tens and sometimes hundreds of keyphrases produced by exhaustive decoding with a large beam size — thus completely ignoring precision.
